info.title: Medorax API
info.description:
Medorax backend API — pharmacy management and healthcare platform.

## Authentication
All protected endpoints require a Bearer token in the `Authorization` header:
```
Authorization: Bearer <access_token>
```

## Token Rotation
Refresh tokens rotate on every use (RTR). Replaying a used refresh token triggers a security event that revokes all sessions for that user.

## Device Management
The client must persist `device_identifier` from the login response and send it on subsequent logins to enforce one-session-per-device.

## Rate Limiting
Authentication endpoints are rate-limited per client IP. Exceeded limits return `429 Too Many Requests` with a `Retry-After` header.
